why: A = theorem_4_2 ∧ theorem_4_2_general (universe 0); B is the same equivalence (i) HasCornerStructure ↔ (ii) X₀ = X_∞, 1₀¹ sc-smooth, centred tame charts with T₀O finite-dimensional in good position, for tame X. Differences are only bookkeeping: smoothSet = univ vs ∀ x, x ∈ smoothSet; A fixes one junk value x₀ : X₁ for 1₀¹ while B quantifies over all (equal once X₀ = X_∞, and for X = ∅ both sides hold trivially; for the (i)⇒(ii) direction of A→B a point of X₁ is produced from a corner chart via Lemma 4.7(i)); conjunct order. B ⇒ theorem_4_2_general (which drops tameness) holds because both (i) (HasCornerStructure.isTame) and (ii) (tame charts cover X, isTame_of_forall_exists_chart) imply tameness, so the extra generality of A is no extra content.
